name: checkStore

versions.rationale: Seed implementation from the plan (Metadata schema and storage); small enough to build and test on day one.
Also validates notes: schema, id matches filename, anchors and check files exist, supersession is valid, and warns when an anchored unit has changed since the note was confirmed.

Enforces removed versions: only last in the chain, exempt from the provisional-hash policy, and a removed unit's file and linked tests need not exist. Warns when a live unit's latest version still depends on a removed one.

A rehash version must have only b3: hashes and follow a git: version. With allowProvisionalHashes off, only each live unit's latest version must be b3:, so recorded history keeps its git: hashes. A note anchored to a unit stays confirmed through rehash versions, since they re-record the same code.

docs:
Validates the whole store: config, lock, every unit file and every note
against their JSON Schemas, then the rules a schema cannot express (ids
match filenames, version chains are intact, references point at real units,
notes and files, and notes are flagged when their units have moved on).
Removed units keep their files but need not point at code that still exists.
